steps.content: Having cleared the remaining statues from the previous gallery incident, you open your terminal to check the latest notifications.

"Shocking! Three phantom thieves infiltrated the city's most secure gallery without a trace!" "Original or forgery? The fierce debate over the breathtaking masterpiece Otherland Angels rages on!" "Despite a joint security operation by the Public Security Bureau and the MBCC, the notorious 'Marauders' still pulled off the heist, reports confirm."

"Why did they target only the Otherland Angels despite the formidable security? Now, that's the real question!" Trending #1: Who exactly are these artwork phantom thieves? Trending #5: Hey Fox and Rabbit, you still around? Care to make a comeback?

steps.speaker: Police Officer
steps.content: Move!! They're getting away!!!

steps.speaker: Police Officer
steps.content: Team One, left flank! Team Two, right! Cut them off! Do not let them escape with that painting!

Late at night on the city's outskirts, near a factory exhibition hall, the red and blue lights of two police squadrons flashed urgently. Sirens pierced the darkness while the vehicles gave desperate chase to three figures racing ahead.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: In eight hundred meters... cliff ahead!

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: We jump on my mark!

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi & Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Understood!
As the police closed the distance, the three sisters wrenched their throttles tighter, waiting with bated breath for the perfect moment to act.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Three... two... one...

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: —Now!
The instant the countdown ended, the three sisters launched their motorcycles over the cliff's edge. In one fluid motion, they sprang from their bikes mid-air.

Propelled by the fiery blast from their cycles erupting below, they soared onto waiting hang gliders and rode the thermal updraft toward their far-off goal. Left behind, the stranded officers could merely stamp the ground in furious helplessness.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Rui, Hitomi, come on, come on! Open it up, let me see!
Back inside the Cat's Eye Café, having changed from her catsuit, Kisugi Ai eagerly beckoned to her sisters, urging them to hold their newly acquired painting under the light.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Don't rush. We have all the time in the world.

With a careful motion, Kisugi Rui unfolded the soft velvet swaddling the painting, unveiling an exquisite and heartwarming scene. To the sisters, every visible brushstroke seemed to radiate the artist's profound love.
It depicted three lovely, elegant angels, their faces beaming with contentment and joy as they gathered around a small, glittering pile of gems.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Three angels and their treasure... This must be how Dad saw us...
Another painting reclaimed meant the sisters were now a step closer to finding their father. Huddled together, they gazed at the piece with tear-filled eyes.
One drop, two drops, three drops...
Their warm, joyful tears fell quietly, but on the floor beneath their feet, each drop formed a strange, spreading ripple.
The rings spread slowly, persistently...
Then, with no warning, the ripple ripped apart into a yawning chasm and devoured the entire café. There was no time to react—only an immediate, total plunge into darkness.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Rui!

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Hitomi! To me!

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: ARGH—What is going on?!

An inexorable, boundless power from the eerie abyss dragged the sisters downward. As they were pulled deeper, the painting in Kisugi Hitomi's hands—the source of their joyful tears—began to fracture, webs of cracks spreading across its surface.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: No! The painting... It's being torn apart!

The moment the darkness consumed them, the cracks multiplied across the painting's surface. Kisugi Hitomi made a desperate, grasping reach, but it was too late. The three angels, once so peacefully nestled, were already torn violently apart.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: No... Don't!
Helpless, the three sisters watched as the cherished painting splintered into three separate pieces before their eyes.
